correctness.rationale: A packet of length l has signed parity (-1)^floor(l/2); the exact first-packet decomposition gives F(z)=(1+qz)/(1-pz+qz^2). The discriminant p^2-4(1-p) determines the real-root positivity regime; rational or irrational angular rotations give infinite sign changes in the complex regime. Sign multiplicativity gives the exact t-pass law. Forty-eight exhaustive rational finite-model checks passed; infinity rests on explicit proof.
